summary.text: Ken Reed is an Independent write-in candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after losing the May 12, 2026 Republican primary to incumbent Darren Thorne.
A pharmacist and the founder of Reed's Pharmacy, he previously served in the West Virginia House of Delegates from 2020 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Ken Reed graduated from Brooke High School in 1986 and earned a degree from the West Virginia School of Pharmacy in 1992.
His career experience includes founding and working as CEO of Reed's Pharmacy.

Reed, a Republican, represented District 59 in the West Virginia House of Delegates from December 1, 2020, to December 1, 2022, and during 2021-2022 was assigned to the Banking and Insurance, Health and Human Resources, Prevention and Treatment of Substance Abuse, and Technology and Infrastructure committees.
In the 2022 Republican primary for House District 90, incumbent George Miller defeated him.
In the 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 15, Darren Thorne received 55.3 percent to Reed's 35.5 percent, and Reed is now on the general election ballot as a write-in candidate.
